answer: A farm running 93 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the lagoon stake is held until the tide settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the nadir audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 28% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
